question: What is Stelar Interior?
answer: Stelar Interior is a premium interior design company that transforms homes and commercial spaces into stunning, functional environments. We specialize in end-to-end interior solutions from concept design to final execution, bringing your dream space to life.

question: Where is Stelar Interior located?
answer: Stelar Interior is based in Kerala, India. We serve clients across Kerala and nearby regions. You can visit our office and showroom to explore our material samples and previous project portfolios.

question: What services does Stelar Interior offer?
answer: We offer complete interior design services including residential interiors, commercial and office interiors, modular kitchen design, wardrobe and storage solutions, false ceiling and lighting design, TV unit and entertainment walls, bathroom and bedroom interiors, living room and dining area design, and full home renovation. We handle everything from concept to completion.

question: Do you do modular kitchen design?
answer: Yes, modular kitchens are one of our specialties. We design custom modular kitchens with optimized storage, premium hardware, and finishes that match your home's style. We offer L-shaped, U-shaped, parallel, and island kitchen layouts.

question: Do you do commercial or office interiors?
answer: Absolutely. We design modern office spaces, retail showrooms, restaurants, and commercial establishments. Our commercial designs focus on functionality, brand identity, and employee productivity.

question: What is the interior design process?
answer: Our process has four stages. First, we do a free site visit and consultation to understand your requirements and take measurements. Second, our design team creates detailed 3D visualizations for your approval. Third, once you approve the design, our skilled team begins fabrication and installation. Finally, we do a quality check and handover. We stay involved at every step.

question: How much does interior design cost?
answer: Our pricing depends entirely on your specific requirements, the space size, materials chosen, and design complexity. We can only provide an accurate estimate after visiting your site and understanding your needs. The initial site visit and consultation are completely free with no obligation.

question: Is the first consultation free?
answer: Yes, your first site visit and consultation are completely free with no obligation. Our designer will visit your location, take measurements, understand your requirements, and discuss design ideas. You only pay once you decide to move forward with a project.

question: What materials does Stelar Interior use?
answer: We use only premium quality materials including marine-grade plywood, high-density MDF, branded laminates from Merino and Greenlam, natural wood veneers, solid wood, quartz and granite countertops, and premium hardware from Hettich and Hafele. We never compromise on material quality.

question: How long does an interior project take?
answer: The timeline depends on the project scope. A single room like a modular kitchen typically takes two to three weeks. A full home interior for a two or three BHK apartment usually takes forty-five to sixty days. Larger villas or commercial projects may take longer. We always provide a clear timeline before starting work.

question: Does Stelar Interior provide warranty?
answer: Yes, we provide a comprehensive warranty on all our work. Our furniture and installations come with a warranty on both workmanship and materials. Hardware components carry their respective brand warranties. We also offer after-sales support for any maintenance needs.

question: How can I schedule a site visit?
answer: You can schedule a free site visit by calling us directly. Just share your name, preferred date and time, and your location. Our design consultant will visit your space, take measurements, and discuss your vision. We typically schedule visits within two to three days of your request.

question: What happens during the first site visit?
answer: During the first visit, our designer will tour your space, take detailed measurements, understand your lifestyle and preferences, discuss design styles you like, talk about your budget range, and suggest initial ideas. We also bring material samples for you to see and touch. The entire visit usually takes about thirty to forty-five minutes.

question: What are your working hours?
answer: Our office is open Monday to Saturday, from nine AM to six PM. Site visits can be scheduled at a time convenient for you, including evenings and weekends by prior arrangement. Our AI assistant is available around the clock to help you schedule a visit.

question: How can I contact Stelar Interior?
answer: You can reach us by phone during our working hours, Monday to Saturday, nine AM to six PM. You can also message us on WhatsApp or visit our showroom directly. Our team is always happy to help with any questions about your interior design project.

question: Do you do renovations and remodeling?
answer: Yes, we handle complete home renovations and remodeling projects. Whether you want to update a single room or do a full home makeover, we can redesign and transform your existing space. We carefully plan renovations to minimize disruption to your daily life.

question: Do you provide 3D design visualizations?
answer: Yes, we create detailed 3D visualizations of your space before any work begins. This lets you see exactly how your interiors will look after completion. We refine the designs based on your feedback until you are fully satisfied before starting execution.

question: Can I customize the designs?
answer: Absolutely. Every project we do is fully customized to your preferences, lifestyle, and space. Nothing is cookie-cutter. You choose the colors, materials, layouts, and style. Our designers work closely with you to create a space that is uniquely yours.

question: What design styles does Stelar Interior work with?
answer: We work with all popular design styles including modern contemporary, minimalist, traditional Indian, Scandinavian, industrial, luxury classic, and transitional styles. Our designers can also blend styles to create a unique look that matches your personality and taste.

question: Do you handle electrical and plumbing work?
answer: Yes, we handle all civil work that is part of the interior project including electrical wiring, plumbing modifications, false ceiling framework, and wall treatments. We coordinate with licensed electricians and plumbers to ensure everything is done safely and to code.
